dedupe_keys.name: a large crowdsourced street view dataset for mapping road surface types in africa

description: A Large Crowdsourced Street View Dataset for Mapping Road Surface Types in Africa is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qi Zhou et al. Identifying road surface types can inform road maintenance and socio-economic development. Crowdsourced street view data, with global coverage and free access, is a valuable source for this task. However, deep learning models typically require large, manually annotated datasets, which are lacking for road surface classification. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 15593920856 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
